description: Export a run as a governance evidence pack: the signed receipt, every entry, a roll-up of the nodes consulted (with pinned versions/hashes), an independent hash-chain + Merkle integrity self-check, and a coversheet mapping the receipt to the record-keeping obligations it supports (EU AI Act Art. 12/26, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF). The pack contains the run's content, so it is returned only to the account that owns the run: pass api_key. Anyone can check a sealed run's integrity with get_run.

api_key.description: Your Bidda key. Required: this export is returned only to the account that owns the run.

name: get_audit_pack
